features.description: residual = price minus session VWAP/linear baseline, in pct of open

open_gap_pct.description: raw open gap vs prior RTH close, pct (absent if unknown)

residual_slope.description: slope of residual vs time, pct per hour

gap_size_class.description: |open_gap_pct| vs gap_threshold_pct: none < 1x, small < 2x, medium < 4x, large

real_gap_filled.description: a real gap (class small/medium/large) was filled

gap_raw.description: raw gap values kept for audit; never put in state

family.instructions: Which intraday pattern family do the features (and `shape_summary`) for `symbol` on `timeframe` describe? Judge the intraday path first; the gap fields are already thresholded in code.

criteria.trend_day: Residual moves steadily one way all session (high residual_r2, large slope, few mean crossings), closes near the extreme; a real gap that is not filled and keeps going is still a trend_day
criteria.reversal: A strong move early in the session is fully retraced and the session closes on the other side of the open
criteria.range: Residual oscillates around zero with many mean crossings, small net change, no persistent slope
criteria.gap_fill: A REAL opening gap (gap_size_class small, medium or large) that is closed back to the prior close during the session (real_gap_filled true). Never gap_fill when gap_size_class is none or unknown, or real_gap_filled is false or absent
criteria.unclear: Features are contradictory or too weak to name a family
criteria.other: A recognisable pattern that is none of the above

criteria: Mixed or contradictory signals
